title: Camelot Device Action
description: v1.2 immutable device-action manifest for mobile actions (calendar, SMS, call, open URL) per §10 and §21. A device action is permitted only when every condition in §10.1 holds: OS permission, device identity, tenant scope, active device-action lease, immutable manifest, explicit confirmation, and cached authority epoch within the §10.3 window. See Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2 §10 + §21.

effect_class.description: Device effect class per §5.5: device.calendar.write, device.sms.send, device.call.initiate.

content.description: Exact action content: recipient, number, event, URL. Must match what the user confirms (§21).

content_hash.description: Hash of the immutable content; user confirms the hash-consistent manifest (§21).

cached_epoch_max_age_min.description: Cached-epoch window in minutes per §10.3 (30 for calendar, 5 for SMS/call).

two_person_required.description: True for T3+ device actions (SMS, call) per §5.5.

os_permission.description: Android OS permission required (via permission broker, §10).
